reviewed_replacements.before: The wiki notes the bonus “is an enhancement bonus, not the regular equipment bonus”, so a diamond does not stack with a worn Spot item of the same type: it replaces it.
reviewed_replacements.after: For the exact Diamond of Spot +22 (ML36), the retained own-item excerpt specifies a +22 Competence bonus. Multiple Competence bonuses to Spot do not add; only the highest applies. This correction does not classify other skill diamonds or levels, establish mixed-type stacking or promise a final +22 skill gain. Exact excerpts and provenance limits.
